info.name: Get Case Assist Configurations by Project

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
Example: `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project for which to retrieve case assist configurations.

params.name: page
params.description:
The 0-based number of the page of configurations to list.
Default: `0`

params.name: perPage
params.description:
The maximum number of configurations to include per page.
Default: `100`

items.docs:
Retrieves case assist configurations associated with a specific project in a [Coveo Cloud organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

Required privilege: Customer Service - Case assist configuration - View
